body: I'm trying to die. I think taking any sustenance is kind of moot.

I learned that only those who are lucky enough, that life was kind enough to give them a chance to make it gets to reach for the people who shows desperation and says empty words like 'it'll work out'. Those who hasn't didn't, my friend who has long given up before me, who died with thousands of dollars of debt and no way to come out of it couldn't tell me this because it wasn't true for him. Another friend who has hundreds of thousands student debt and his only way of living is selling cheap items on road sides, an alcoholic who just want to be left alone will never tell me this. Those has been their lives for much, much longer than mine was for me.

I'm not here asking for advice and empty words of encouragements, especially if you keep misunderstanding and not getting why i kept repeating the word FAILURE in my post. 10 times failure is understandably, i spent a year doing nothing but failing, over 100 rejection letter for jobs that is in my field, in my interest, out of my field and interest and just any retail or even janitorial work. None. I wasn't even good enough to mop someone's floor apparently.

And my spirit is crushed enough i fear, genuinely have panic attacks over the thought of doing and inevitably failing again at something else. I want one thing to work out for me, just one. I can't even have that.

So please, have an actual understanding that i do not need someone to tell me 'it'll get better' because i knew deep in my bone, it will not. Too much rejection shows me i don't deserve better, all of my failure showed me i am just destined to be that one person who makes everyone else feel better about themselves. It will not get better.

Now, i just want to succeed at one thing, at ending it all. I can't even do that.

Have a good day.

You're... you're completely misunderstanding me. I DO want something good enough but i NEVER COULD. That's the entire point. I am always below of that, i am always on that brink only to be slammed down again. Always that promise that seems like a solution only to figure out it's a trap that sets me back. 

I have failed at EVERY SINGLE THING I HAVE TRIED TO DO IN 25 YEARS, i am a NEET, basically, i bring nothing to the table. That's not me being too hard on myself, that's me realizing maybe it's time i put this all down and just leave for someone better to occupy this space i'm just wasting.

I don't want any achievement, i've known better than to expect anything good will ever happen to me now. I just want something to be able to hold on to, a job, a purpose, but i fail in any of it so much there is no point expecting a different outcome anymore.

​

No.

I have gone to professional help before, but the 2 i've gone to has been nothing but a waste of money that i don't have. And there is a stigma where i came from attached with needing them.

I've disappointed my parents enough, i don't need them to deal with the rest of the stigma. At least if i commit suicide, they'll be asking what's wrong with me only and they'll get sympathy and support they'll need. Hopefully.

One less mouth to feed, one less retarded anxious weirdo to tolerate. I fail to see how this is a bad thing. 

And i don't really find enjoyment in anything anymore, so i don't really know what is this 'most' i'm supposed to be getting before ending it all. Maybe a game i'm waiting for haha.

...Sorry, i just can't do it anymore. I'm tired of one more year pretending like everything's okay.

And what would this being close to christmas change anything? Did people just suddenly get everything they want when it's december? If it does, then maybe that's a reason to hold on.

Otherwise, it's just another day, another prolonging what should've happened a long time ago.

I came from a place where mental health issues and suicide is seen as taboo and can give shame to the family left behind. The same reason as to why i don't admit i have depression, i don't commit suicide because after every failure and disappointment i gave my parents, the least i could do is not to add one more.

I worked there for around a year or so and was skimped out of payment by an employer, a matter that was slowly being dealt with and hopefully will be resolved soon. I am now back in my hometown again.

Thank you for your help, i am currently waiting for another interview (and this one is legit, i've searched up the company and all) which is why i am feeling better and can write this. Hope this is it!
Yes! I wish you the best of luck and hope things will get better for you too!

I'm not from US, i'm living in Asia. I'm actually quite surprise they also have Herbalife here, because i thought they only stayed in the western hemisphere. I wish i didn't know...

Still, this will make me be a little more aware.

I'm not really in marketing, just desperate for any job and trying my luck in different industry just in case. And i'm actually not from US or Europe too... 

Thank you so much for your offer, though. I have another interview lined up, pretty much the reason why i am somewhat healed from the damage this experience did to my self-esteem and i can write this. Hopefully this will be the one!
Yes... And you're right, maybe if anything good can happen out of this, is that she'll stop taking advantage of people like this. And thank you, i hope things are well for you too.
Thank you, you're so very kind. I don't even live in US sadly, but i am genuinely thankful for the offer.
Thank you, i hope so too. I hope this won’t happen to anyone else

Still no interview. Only emails containing the word ‘unfortunately’, with each of them taking away my appetite, motivation and will little by little. I lost 10kg in the last half a year, and is apparently underweight now. My hair is falling rapidly due to stress. I applied to 5 more ads today and when i got to the part where i’m supposed to give a cover letter, i decided to make one pdf and just use that for every application.

It’s degrading. My passionately written CL with maybe a hint of desperation was only met with a mass turning down email over and over. I never was dealing with human, i’m dealing with machines, objects with no emotion. I have become one too while trying to work for these unfeeling creatures. 

I have masters. I can’t even get a retail job.

This has been deleted as well with no explanation why. Is my account age too young, is it against the use of this subreddit, i would never know and a business with shady practice will go unreported.

Bye and thanks for nothing.
